ja545:1.1: Ahu rājā Videhānaṃ Aṃgati nāma khattiyo pahūtayoggo dhanimā anantabalaporiso.
ja545:2.1: So ca pannarasiṃ rattiṃ purime yāme anāgate cātumassakomudiyā amacce sannipātayi:
ja545:3.1: Paṇḍite sutasampanne mihitapubbe vicakkhaṇe Vijayañ ca Sunāmañ ca senāpatim Alātakaṃ.
ja545:4.1: Tam anupucchi Vedeho: paccekaṃ brūtha saṃ ruciṃ, cātumassakomud' ajja, juṇhaṃ, vyapagataṃ tamaṃ, kāy' ajja ratiyā rattiṃ viharemu imaṃ utun
ja545:5.1: ti. Tato senāpatī rañño Alāto etad abravī: haṭṭhaṃ yoggaṃ balaṃ sabbaṃ senaṃ sannāhayāmase.
ja545:6.1: Niyyāma deva yuddhāya anantabalaporisā, ye te vasaṃ na āyanti vasaṃ upanayāmase, esā mayhaṃ sakā diṭṭhi: ajitaṃ ojināmase.
ja545:7.1: Alātassa vaco sutvā Sunāmo etad abravī: sabbe tuyhaṃ mahārāja amittā va samāgatā,
ja545:8.1: Nikkhittasatthā paccattā nivātam anuvattare, uttamo ussavo ajja, na yuddhaṃ mama ruccati.
ja545:9.1: Annaṃ pānañ ca khajjañ ca khippaṃ abhiharantu te, ramassu deva kāmehi naccagītesu vādite.
ja545:10.1: Sunāmassa vaco sutvā Vijayo etad abravī: sabbe kāmā mahārāja niccaṃ tava-m-upaṭṭhitā,
ja545:11.1: Na h' ete dullabhā deva tava kāmehi modituṃ, sadāpi kāmā labbhanti n' etaṃ cittaṃ mataṃ mama.
ja545:12.1: Samaṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vāpi upāsemu bahussutaṃ yo n' ajja vinaye kaṃkhaṃ atthadhammavidū ise.
ja545:13.1: Vijayassa vaco sutvā rājā Aṃgati-m-abravī: yathā Vijayo bhaṇati mayham p' et' eva ruccati.
ja545:14.1: Samaṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vāpi upāsemu bahussutaṃ yo n' ajja vinaye kaṃkhaṃ atthadhammavidū ise.
ja545:15.1: Sabbe va [santā] karotha matiṃ: kaṃ upāsemu paṇḍitaṃ, ko n' ajja vinaye kaṃkhaṃ atthadhammavidū ise.
ja545:16.1: Vedehassa vaco sutvā Alāto etad abravī: atth' āyaṃ migadāyasmiṃ acelo dhīrasammato
ja545:17.1: Guṇo Kassapagott' āyaṃ suto citrakathī gaṇī, taṃ deva payirupāsaya, so no kaṃkhaṃ vinessati.
ja545:18.1: Alātassa vaco sutvā rājā codesi sārathiṃ: migadāyaṃ gamissāma, yuttaṃ yānaṃ idhānayā
ja545:19.1: 'ti. Tassa yānaṃ ayojesuṃ dantaṃ rūpiyapakkharaṃ sukkamaṭṭhaparivāraṃ paṇḍaraṃ dosināmukhaṃ.
ja545:20.1: Tatrāsuṃ kumudā yuttā cattāro sindhavā hayā anilūpamasamuppādā sudantā soṇṇamālino
ja545:21.1: Setacchattaṃ setaratho setassā setavījanī, Vedeho sah' amaccehi niyyaṃ Cando va sobhatha.
ja545:22.1: Tam annuyāyuṃ bahavo iṭṭhikhaggadharā balī assapiṭṭhigatā dhīrā narā naravarādhipaṃ.
ja545:23.1: So muhuttaṃ va yāyitvā yānā oruyha khattiyo Vedeho sah' amaccehi patti Guṇam upāgami.
ja545:24.1: Ye pi tattha tadā āsuṃ brāhmaṇibbhā samāgatā na te apanayī rājā akataṃ bhūmim āgate
ja545:25.1: ti. Tato [so] mudukābhisiyā muducittakaḷandake mudupaccatthate rājā ekamantaṃ upāvisi.
ja545:26.1: Nisajja rājā sammodi kathaṃ sārāṇiyaṃ tato: kacci yāpanīyam bhante vātānam avisaggatā,
ja545:27.1: Kacci akasirā vutti, labbhati piṇḍayāpanaṃ, appābādho v' asī kacci cakkhuṃ na parihāyati.
ja545:28.1: Taṃ Guṇo paṭisammodi Vedehaṃ vinaye rataṃ: yāpanīyaṃ mahārāja sabbam etaṃ tad ūbhayaṃ.
ja545:29.1: Kacci tuyham pi Vedeha paccantā na balīyare, kacci ārogaṃ yoggan te, kacci vahati vāhanaṃ, kacci te vyādhayo n' atthi sarīrass' upatāpikā.
ja545:30.1: Paṭisammodito rājā tato pucchi anantarā atthaṃ dhammaṃ ca ñāyañ ca dhammakāmo rathesabho.
ja545:31.1: Kathaṃ dhammaṃ care macco mātāpitūsu Kassapa, kathaṃ care ācariye puttadāre kathaṃ care.
ja545:32.1: Kathaṃ careyya vaddhesu kathaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇe, kathañ ca balakāyasmiṃ kathaṃ jānapade care.
ja545:33.1: Kathaṃ dhammaṃ caritvāna pecca gacchati suggatiṃ, kathaṃ c' eke adhammaṭṭhā patanti nirayaṃ adho ti.
ja545:34.1: Vedehassa vaco sutvā Kassapo etad abravī: suṇohi me mahārāja saccaṃ avitathaṃ padaṃ,
ja545:35.1: N' atthi dhammacaritassa phalaṃ kalyāṇapāpakaṃ, n' atthi deva paro loko, ko tato hi idhāgato,
ja545:36.1: N' atthi deva pitaro vā, kuto mātā kuto pitā, n' atthi ācariyo nāma, adantaṃ ko damissati,
ja545:37.1: Samatulyāni bhūtāni, n' atthi jeṭṭhāpacāyino, n' atthi balaṃ vā viriyaṃ vā, kuto uṭṭhānaporisaṃ, niyatāni hi bhūtāni, yathā goṭaviso tathā,
ja545:38.1: Laddheyyaṃ labhate macco, tattha dānaphalaṃ kuto, n' atthi dānaphalaṃ deva, avaso dev' avīriyo,
ja545:39.1: Bālehi dānaṃ paññattaṃ paṇḍitehi paṭicchitaṃ, avasā denti dhīrānaṃ bālā paṇḍitamānino ti.
ja545:40.1: Satt' ime sassatā kāyā acchejjā avikopino: tejo paṭhavī āpo ca vāyo sukhadukhañ c' ime jīvo ca, satt' ime kāyā yesaṃ chettā na vijjati,
ja545:41.1: N' atthi hantā vā chettā vā haññare vāpi koci naṃ, antaren' eva kāyānaṃ satthāni vītivattare.
ja545:42.1: Yo p' āyaṃ siraṃ ādāya paresaṃ nisitāsinā na so chindati te kāye, tattha pāpaphalaṃ kuto.
ja545:43.1: Cullāsītimahākappe sabbe sujjhanti saṃsaraṃ, anāgate tamhi kāle saññato pi na sujjhati.
ja545:44.1: Caritvāpi bahuṃ bhadraṃ n' eva sujjhanti nāgate, pāpañ ce pi bahuṃ katvā taṃ khaṇaṃ nātivattare.
ja545:45.1: Anupubbena no suddhi kappānaṃ cullasītiyā, niyatiṃ nātivattāma velantam iva sāgaro ti.
ja545:46.1: Kassapassa vaco sutvā Alāto etad abravī: yathā bhadanto bhaṇati mayhaṃ p' etaṃ ca ruccati.
ja545:47.1: Aham pi purimaṃ jātiṃ sare saṃsarit' attano, Piṅgalo nām' ahaṃ āsiṃ luddo goghātako pure.
ja545:48.1: Bārāṇasiyaṃ phītāya bahuṃ pāpaṃ kataṃ mayā, bahū mayhaṃ hatā pāṇā: mahisā sūkarā ajā.
ja545:49.1: Tato cuto idha jāto iddhe senāpatīkule n' atthi nūna phalaṃ pāpe so 'haṃ na nirayaṃ gato ti.
ja545:50.1: Ath' ettha Bījako nāma dāso āsi paḷaccarī, uposathaṃ upavasanto Guṇasantikam upāgami.
ja545:51.1: Kassapassa vaco sutvā Alātassa ca bhāsitaṃ passasanto muhuṃ uṇhaṃ rudaṃ assūni vattayīti.
ja545:52.1: Tam annupucchi Vedeho: kimatthaṃ samma rodasi, kin te sutaṃ vā diṭṭhaṃ vā, kiṃ maṃ vedesi vedanan ti.
ja545:53.1: Vedehassa vaco sutvā Bījako etad abravī: n' atthi me vedanā dukkhā, mahārāja suṇohi me.
ja545:54.1: Aham pi purimaṃ jātiṃ sarāmi sukham attano: Sāketāyaṃ pure āsiṃ Bhāvaseṭṭhi guṇe rato
ja545:55.1: Sammato brāhmaṇibbhānaṃ saṃvibhāgarato suci, na cāpi pāpakaṃ kammaṃ sarāmi katam attano.
ja545:56.1: Tato cut' āhaṃ Vedeha idha jāto duritthiyā gabbhamhi kumbhadāsiyā yato jāto suduggato.
ja545:57.1: Evam pi duggato santo samacariyaṃ adhiṭṭhito upaḍḍhabhāgaṃ bhattassa dadāmi yo me icchati.
ja545:58.1: Cātuddasiṃ pañcadasiṃ sadā upavasām' ahaṃ, na cāpi bhūte hiṃsāmi theyyañ cāpi vivajjayiṃ.
ja545:59.1: Sabbam eva hi nūn' etaṃ suciṇṇaṃ bhavati nipphalaṃ, niratthaṃ maññ' idaṃ sīlaṃ Alāto bhāsatī yathā.
ja545:60.1: Kalim eva nūna gaṇhāmi asippo dhuttako yathā, kaṭaṃ Alāto gaṇhāti kitavā sikkhito yathā.
ja545:61.1: Dvāraṃ na-ppatipassāmi yena gacchāmi suggatiṃ, tasmā rāja parodāmi sutvā Kassapabhāsitan ti.
ja545:62.1: Bījakassa vaco sutvā rājā Aṅgati-m-abravī: n' atthi dvāraṃ sugatiyā niyatiṃ kaṃkha Bījaka.
ja545:63.1: Sukhaṃ vā yadivā dukkhaṃ niyatiyā kira labbhati saṃsārasuddhi sabbesaṃ, mā turittho anāgate.
ja545:64.1: Aham pi pubbe kalyāṇo brāhmaṇibbhesu vyāvaṭo vohāraṃ anusāsanto ratihīno tadantarā ti.
ja545:65.1: Puna pi bhante dakkhemu saṅgati ce bhavissatīti. Idaṃ vatvāna Vedeho paccagā sanivesanan
ja545:66.1: ti. Tato ratyā vivasane upaṭṭhānamhi Aṅgati amacce sannipātetvā idaṃ vacanam abravi:
ja545:67.1: Candake me vimānasmiṃ sadā kāme vidhentu me, mā m' ūpagañchuṃ atthesu guyhappākāsiyesu ca.
ja545:68.1: Vijayo ca Sunāmo ca senāpati Alātako ete atthe nisīdantu vohārakusalā tayo.
ja545:69.1: Idaṃ vatvāna Vedeho kāme ca bahumaññatha, na cāpi brāhmaṇibbhesu atthe kismiñci vyāvaṭo
ja545:70.1: ti. Tato dvesattarattassa Vedehass' atrajā piyā rājakaññā Rujā nāma dhātimātaram abravi:
ja545:71.1: Alaṃkarotha maṃ khippaṃ, sakhiyo ca karontu me, suve pannaraso dibbo, gacchaṃ issarasantike.
ja545:72.1: Tassā malyaṃ abhihariṃsu candanañ ca mahārahaṃ maṇisaṃkhamuttāratanaṃ nānāratte ca ambare.
ja545:73.1: Tañ ca sovaṇṇaye pīṭhe nisinnaṃ bahukitthiyo parikiriya asobhiṃsu Rujaṃ ruciravaṇṇinin ti.
ja545:74.1: Sā ca sakhīmajjhagatā sabbābharaṇabhūsitā sateratā abbham iva Candakaṃ pāvisī Rujā.
ja545:75.1: Upasaṃkamitvā Vedehaṃ vanditvā vinaye rataṃ suvaṇṇavikate pīṭhe ekamantaṃ upāvisīti.
ja545:76.1: Tañ ca disvāna Vedeho accharānaṃ va saṅgamaṃ Rujaṃ sakhīmajjhagataṃ idaṃ vacanam abravī:
ja545:77.1: Kacci ramasi pāsāde antopokkharaṇiṃ pati, kacci bahuvidhaṃ khajjaṃ sadā abhiharanti te.
ja545:78.1: Kacci bahuvidhaṃ malyaṃ ocinitvā kumāriyo gharake karotha paccekaṃ khiḍḍāratiratā muhuṃ.
ja545:79.1: Kena vā vikalaṃ tuyhaṃ khippaṃ abhiharantu te, mano karassu kuḍḍamukhī api candasamamhi pīti.
ja545:80.1: Vedehassa vaco sutvā Rujā pitaram abravi: sabbam etaṃ mahārāja labbhat' issarasantike.
ja545:81.1: Suve pannaraso dibbo, sahassaṃ āharantu me, yathā dinnañ ca dassāmi dānaṃ sabbavanīsu 'han ti.
ja545:82.1: Rujāya vacanaṃ sutvā rājā Aṅgati-m-abravi: bahuṃ vināsitaṃ vittaṃ niratthaṃ aphalan tayā.
ja545:83.1: Uposathe vasaṃ niccaṃ annapānaṃ na bhuñjasi, niyat' etaṃ abhuttabbaṃ, n' atthi puññaṃ abhuñjato ti.
ja545:84.1: Bījako pi hi sutvāna tadā Kassapabhāsitaṃ passasanto muhuṃ uṇhaṃ rudaṃ assūni vattayi.
ja545:85.1: Yāva Ruje jīvasi no mā bhattam apanāmayi, n' atthi bhadde paro loko, kiṃ niratthaṃ vihaññasīti.
ja545:86.1: Vedehassa vaco sutvā Rujā ruciravaṇṇinī jānaṃ pubbāparaṃ dhammaṃ pitaraṃ etad abravi:
ja545:87.1: Sutaṃ eva pure āsi sakkhi diṭṭham idaṃ mayā: bālūpasevī yo hoti bālo va samapajjatha.
ja545:88.1: Mūḷho hi mūḷham āgamma bhiyyo mohaṃ nigacchati, patirūpaṃ Alātena Bījakena ca muyhitun
ja545:89.1: ti. Tvañ ca devāsi sappañño dhīro atthassa kovido, kathaṃ bālehi sadisaṃ hīnaṃ diṭṭhim upāgamī.
ja545:90.1: Sace hi saṃsārapathena sujjhati niratthiyā pabbajjā Guṇassa, kīṭo va aggiṃ jalitaṃ apāpataṃ upapajjatī momuho naggabhāvaṃ.
ja545:91.1: Saṃsārasuddhīti pure niviṭṭhā kammaṃ vidūsenti bahū ajānaṃ pubbe kalī duggahito va atthā dummocayā balisā ambujo vā 'ti.
ja545:92.1: Upaman te karissāmi mahārāja tav' atthiyā, upamāya pi ekacce atthaṃ jānanti paṇḍitā.
ja545:93.1: Vānijānaṃ yathā nāvā appamāṇaharā garu atibhāraṃ samādāya aṇṇave avasīdati
ja545:94.1: Evam eva naro pāpaṃ thokathokaṃ pi ācinaṃ atibhāraṃ samādāya niraye avasīdati.
ja545:95.1: Na tāva bhāro paripūro Alātassa mahīpati ācināti etaṃ pāpaṃ yena gacchati duggatiṃ.
ja545:96.1: Pubbe c' assa kataṃ puññaṃ Alātassa mahīpati, tass' eva deva nissando yañ c' eso labhate sukhaṃ.
ja545:97.1: Khiyyate c' assa taṃ puññaṃ tathā hi aguṇe rato, ujumaggaṃ avahāya kummaggam anudhāvati.
ja545:98.1: Tulā yathā paggahitā ohite tulamaṇḍale unnameti tulāsīsaṃ bhāre oropite sati
ja545:99.1: Evam eva naro puññaṃ thokathokam pi ācinaṃ saggātimāno dāso va Bījako sātave rato ti.
ja545:100.1: Yam ajja Bījako dāso dukkhaṃ passati attani pubbe tassa kataṃ pāpaṃ tam eso paṭisevati.
ja545:101.1: Khīyate c' assa taṃ pāpaṃ tathā hi vinaye rato Kassapañ ca samāpajja mā h' ev' uppatham āgamā ti.
ja545:102.1: Yaṃ yaṃ hi rājā bhajati sataṃ vā yadivā asaṃ (IV 435|21) sīlavantaṃ visīlaṃ vā vasaṃ tass' eva gacchati.
ja545:103.1: Yādisaṃ kurute mittaṃ yādisaṃ c' ūpasevati so pi tādisako hoti sahavāso hi tādiso.
ja545:104.1: Sevamāno sevamānaṃ samphuṭṭho samphusaṃ paraṃ saro diddho kalāpaṃ va alittaṃ upalimpati, upalepabhayā dhīro n' eva pāpasakhā siyā.
ja545:105.1: Pūtimacchaṃ kusaggena yo naro upanayhati kusāpi pūtī vāyanti, evaṃ bālūpasevanā.
ja545:106.1: Tagarañ ca palāsena yo naro upanayhati pattāpi surabhī vāyanti, evaṃ dhīrūpasevanā.
ja545:107.1: Tasmā phalapuṭasseva ñatvā sampākam attano asante n' ūpaseveyya sante seveyya paṇḍito, asanto nirayaṃ nenti, santo pāpenti suggatin ti.
ja545:108.1: Aham pi jātiyo satta sare saṃsarit' attano anāgatāpi satt' eva yā gamissaṃ ito cutā.
ja545:109.1: Yā me sā sattamī jāti ahu pubbe janādhipa kammāraputto Magadhe [su] ahu Rājagahe pure.
ja545:110.1: Pāpaṃ sahāyaṃ āgamma bahuṃ pāpaṃ kataṃ mayā paradārassa heṭhento carimha amarā viya.
ja545:111.1: Taṃ kammaṃ nihitaṃ aṭṭhā bhasmācchanno va pāvako, atha aññehi kammehi ajāyiṃ Vaṃsabhūmiyaṃ
ja545:112.1: Kosambiyaṃ seṭṭhikule iddhe phīte mahaddhane ekaputto mahārāja niccaṃ sakkatapūjito.
ja545:113.1: Tattha mittaṃ asevissaṃ sahāyaṃ sātave rataṃ paṇḍitaṃ sutasampannaṃ, so maṃ atthe nivesayi.
ja545:114.1: Cātuddasiṃ pañcadasiṃ bahuṃ rattim upāvasiṃ, taṃ kammaṃ nihitaṃ aṭṭhā, nidhīva udakantike.
ja545:115.1: Atha pāpānaṃ kammānaṃ yam etaṃ Magadhe kataṃ phalaṃ pariyāgataṃ pacchā bhutvā duṭṭhavisaṃ yathā
ja545:116.1: Tato cut' āhaṃ Vedeha Roruve niraye ciraṃ, sakammanā apaccisaṃ, taṃ saraṃ na sukhaṃ labhe.
ja545:117.1: Bahuvassagaṇe tattha khepayitvā bahuṃ dukhaṃ Bheṇṇākaṭe ahuṃ rāja chakalo uddhitapphalo ti.
ja545:118.1: Sātaputtā mayā vūḷhā piṭṭhiyā ca rathena ca, tassa kammassa nissando paradāragamanassa me
ja545:119.1: ti. Tato cut' āhaṃ Vedeha kapi āsiṃ brahāvane nilicchitaphalo yeva yūthapena pagabbhinā, tassa kammassa nissando paradāragamanassa me
ja545:120.1: ti. Tato cut' āhaṃ Vedeha Dasaṇṇesu pasū ahuṃ nilicchito javo bhadro, yoggaṃ vūḷhaṃ ciraṃ mayā, tassa kammassa nissando paradāragamanassa me.
ja545:121.1: Tato cut' āhaṃ Vedeha Vajjīsu kulam āgamaṃ, n' ev' itthī na pumā āsiṃ manussatte sudullabhe, tassa kammassa nissando paradāragamanassa me.
ja545:122.1: Tato cut' āhaṃ Vedeha ajāyiṃ Nandane vane, bhavane Tāvatiṃs' ahaṃ accharā kāmavaṇṇinī
ja545:123.1: Vicittavatthābharaṇā āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā kusalā naccagītassa Sakkassa paricārikā.
ja545:124.1: Tattha ṭhitāhaṃ Vedeha sarāmi jātiyo imā anāgatāpi satt' eva yā gamissaṃ ito cutā.
ja545:125.1: Pariyāgatan taṃ kusalaṃ yam me Kosambiyaṃ kataṃ deve c' eva manusse ca sandhāvissaṃ ito cutā.
ja545:126.1: Sattajaccā mahārāja niccaṃ sakkatapūjitā, thībhāvāpi na muccissaṃ chaṭṭhā nigatiyo imā.
ja545:127.1: Sattamī ca gati deva: devaputto mahiddhiko pumadevo bhavissāmi devakāyasmim uttamo.
ja545:128.1: Ajjāpi santānamayaṃ mālaṃ ganthenti Nandane devaputto Javo nāma yo me mālaṃ paṭicchati.
ja545:129.1: Muhutto viya so dibbo imāni vassāni soḷasa, rattindivo ca so dibbo mānusī sarado sataṃ.
ja545:130.1: Iti kammāni anventi asaṃkheyyāpi jātiyo kalyāṇaṃ yadivā pāpaṃ, na hi kammaṃ panassatīti.
ja545:131.1: Yo icche puriso hotuṃ jātijātiṃ punappunaṃ paradāraṃ vivajjeyya dhotapādo va kaddamaṃ.
ja545:132.1: Yo icche puriso hotuṃ jātijātiṃ punappunaṃ sāmikaṃ apacāyeyya Indaṃ va paricārikā.
ja545:133.1: Yo icche {dibbabhogañ} ca dibbaṃ āyu{} yasaṃ sukhaṃ pāpāni parivajjetvā tividhaṃ dhammam ācare.
ja545:134.1: Kāyena vācā manasā appamatto vicakkhaṇo attano hoti atthāya itthi vā yadivā pumā.
ja545:135.1: Ye kec' ime manujā jīvaloke yasassino sabbasamantabhogā asaṃsayaṃ tehi pure suciṇṇaṃ kammassakā ye puthu sabbasattā.
ja545:136.1: Iṃghānucintesi sayam pi deva kutonidānā te imā janinda yā te imā accharāsannikāsā alaṃkatā kañcanajālachannā
ja545:137.1: ti. Icc-evaṃ pitaraṃ kaññā Rujā tosesi Aṅgatiṃ, mūḷhassa maggam ācikkhi, dhammam akkhāsi subbatā ti.
ja545:138.1: Athāgamā Brahmalokā Nārado mānusiṃ pajaṃ, Jambudīpaṃ avekkhanto adda rājānam Aṅgatiṃ.
ja545:139.1: Tato patiṭṭhā pāsāde Vedehassa puratthato tañ ca disvā anuppattaṃ Rujā isim avandathā 'ti.
ja545:140.1: Athāsanamhā oruyha rājā vyamhitamānaso Nāradaṃ paripucchanto idaṃ vacanam abravi:
ja545:141.1: Kuto nu āgacchasi devavaṇṇī obhāsayaṃ saṃvariṃ Candimā va. akkhāhi me pucchito nāmagottaṃ kathaṃ taṃ jānanti manussaloke ti.
ja545:142.1: Ahaṃ hi devato idāni emi obhāsayaṃ saṃvariṃ Candimā va, akkhāmi te pucchito nāmagottaṃ jānanti maṃ Nārado Kassapo cā 'ti.
ja545:143.1: Acchariyarūpaṃ vata yādisañ ca vehāsayaṃ gacchasi tiṭṭhasī ca, pucchāmi taṃ Nārada etam atthaṃ: atha kena vaṇṇena tavāyam iddhīti.
ja545:144.1: Saccañ ca dhammo ca damo ca cāgo guṇā mam' ete pakatā purāṇā, teh' eva dhammehi susevitehi manojavo yenakāmaṃ gato 'smīti.
ja545:145.1: Acchariyam ācikkhasi puññasiddhiṃ, sace hi ete tvaṃ yathā vadesi pucchāmi taṃ Nārada etam atthaṃ, puṭṭho ca me sādhu viyākarohīti.
ja545:146.1: Pucchassu maṃ rāja, tav' esa attho, yaṃ saṃsayaṃ kuruse bhūmipāla, ahaṃ taṃ nissaṃsayataṃ gamemi nayehi ñāyehi ca hetubhī cā 'ti.
ja545:147.1: Pucchāmi taṃ Nārada etam atthaṃ puṭṭho ca me Nārada mā musā bhaṇi: atthi nu devā pitaro nu atthi loko paro atthi jano yam āhū 'ti.
ja545:148.1: Atth' eva devā pitaro ca atthi loko paro atthi jano yam āhu, kāmesu giddhā ca narā pamūḷhā lokaṃ paraṃ na vidū mohayuttā ti.
ja545:149.1: Atthīti ce Nārada saddahāsi nivesanaṃ paraloke matānaṃ idh' eva me pañca satāni dehi dassāmi te paraloke sahassan ti.
ja545:150.1: Dajjemu kho pañca satāni bhoto jaññāma ce sīlavantaṃ vadaññuṃ, luddan taṃ bhontaṃ niraye vasantaṃ ko codaye paraloke sahassaṃ.
ja545:151.1: Idh' eva yo hoti akammasīlo pāpācāro alaso luddakammo na paṇḍitā tasmiṃ iṇaṃ dadanti, na hi āgamo hoti tathāvidhamhā.
ja545:152.1: Dakkhañ ca posaṃ manujā viditvā uṭṭhānakaṃ sīlavantaṃ vadaññuṃ sayam bhogehi nimantayanti, kammaṃ karitvā punam āharesīti.
ja545:153.1: Ito gato dakkhasi tattha rājā kākolasaṅghehi pi kaḍḍhamānaṃ taṃ khajjamānaṃ niraye vasantaṃ, kākehi gijjhehi ca senakehi saṃchinnagattaṃ ruhiraṃ savantaṃ, ko codaye paraloke sahassan ti.
ja545:154.1: Andhaṃ tamaṃ tattha na Canda-Suriyā, nirayo sadā tumulo ghorarūpo, sā n' eva rattī na divā ti paññāyati, tathāvidhe ko vicare dhanatthiko ti.
ja545:155.1: Sabalo ca Sāmo ca duve suvānā pavaddhakāyā balino mahantā khādanti dantehi ayomayehi ito panuṇṇaṃ paralokapattan
ja545:156.1: ti. Taṃ khajjamānaṃ niraye vasantaṃ luddehi vālehi aghammigehi ca saṃchinnagattaṃ ruhiraṃ savantaṃ ko codaye paroloke sahassan ti.
ja545:157.1: Usūhi sattīhi sunissitāhi hananti vijjhanti ca paccamittā Kāḷūpakāḷā nirayamhi ghore pubbe naraṃ dukkaṭakammakārin
ja545:158.1: ti. Taṃ haññamānaṃ niraye vajantaṃ kucchismiṃ passasmiṃ viphālitūdaraṃ saṃchinnagattaṃ ruhiraṃ savantaṃ ko codaye paraloke sahassan ti.
ja545:159.1: Sattīusūtomarabhindivālā vividhāvudhā vassati tattha devo patanti aṅgāra-m-iv' accimanto, silāsanī vassati luddakamme ti.
ja545:160.1: Uṇho ca vāto nirayamhi dussaho, na tahiṃ sukhaṃ labbhati ittaram pi, taṃ taṃ vidhāvantam alenam āturaṃ ko codaye paraloke sahassan ti.
ja545:161.1: Sandhāvamānaṃ taṃ rathesu yuttaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ paṭhaviṃ kamantaṃ patodalaṭṭhīhi su codiyantaṃ ko codaye paraloke sahassan
ja545:162.1: ti. Tam āruhantaṃ khurasaṃcitaṃ giriṃ vibhiṃsanaṃ pajjalitaṃ bhayānakaṃ sañchinnagattaṃ ruhiraṃ savantaṃ ko codaye paraloke sahassan
ja545:163.1: ti. Tam āruhantaṃ pabbatasannikāsaṃ aṅgārarāsiṃ jalitaṃ bhayānakaṃ sandaḍḍhagattaṃ kapaṇaṃ rudantaṃ ko codaye paraloke sahassan ti.
ja545:164.1: Abbhakūṭasamā uccā kaṇṭakāpacitā dumā ayomayehi tikkhehi naralohitapāyihīti.
ja545:165.1: Tam āruhanti nāriyo narā ca paradāragū coditā sattihatthehi Yamaniddesakārihīti.
ja545:166.1: Tam āruhantaṃ nirayaṃ simbaliṃ ruhiramakkhitaṃ viduṭṭhakāyaṃ vitacaṃ āturaṃ gāḷhavedanaṃ
ja545:167.1: Passasantaṃ muhuṃ uṇhaṃ pubbakammāparādhikaṃ dumagge vitacagattaṃ ko taṃ yāceyya taṃ dhanan ti.
ja545:168.1: Abbhakūṭasamā uccā asipattācitā dumā ayomayehi tikkhehi naralohitapāyihīti.
ja545:169.1: Tam ānupattaṃ asipattapādapaṃ asīhi tikkhehi ca chijjamānaṃ sañchinnagattaṃ ruhiraṃ savantaṃ ko codaye paraloke sahassan
ja545:170.1: ti. Tato nikkhantamattan taṃ asipattanirayā dukhā sampatitaṃ Vetaraṇiṃ ko taṃ yāceyya taṃ dhanan ti.
ja545:171.1: Kharā kharodikā tattā duggā Vetaraṇī nadī ayopokkharasañchannā tikkhapattehi sandatīti.
ja545:172.1: Tattha sañchinnagattaṃ taṃ vuyhantaṃ ruhiramakkhitaṃ Vetaraññe anālambe ko taṃ yāceyya taṃ dhanan ti.
ja545:173.1: Vedhāmi rukkho viya chijjamāno, disaṃ na jānāmi pamūḷhasaññī, bhayasānutappāmi mahā ca me bhayā sutvāna gāthā tava bhāsitā ise.
ja545:174.1: Āditte vārimajjhaṃ va dīpaṃ v' oghe-r-iv' aṇṇave andhakāre va pajjoto tvaṃ no si saraṇaṃ ise.
ja545:175.1: Atthañ ca dhammañ ca anusāsa maṃ ise, atītam addhā aparādhitaṃ mayā, ācikkha me Nārada suddhimaggaṃ yathā ahaṃ no niraye pateyyan ti.
ja545:176.1: Yathā ahū Dhataraṭṭho Vessāmitto ca Aṭṭhako Yāmataggi . . . Usinnaro cāpi Sivī ca rājā parivārakā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ
ja545:177.1: Ete c' aññe ca rājāno ye Sakkavisayaṃ gatā adhammaṃ parivajjetvā dhammaṃ cara mahīpati.
ja545:178.1: Annahatthā ca te vyamhe ghosayantu pure tava: ko chāto ko ca tasito ko mālaṃ ko vilepanaṃ nānārattānaṃ vatthānaṃ ko naggo paridahessati,
ja545:179.1: Ko panthe chattam ādeti pādukā ca mudū subhā, iti sāyañ ca pāto ca ghosayantu pure tava.
ja545:180.1: Jiṇṇaṃ posaṃ gavassañ ca mā-ssu yuñji yathā pure, parihārañ ca dajjāsi, adhikārakato balīti.
ja545:181.1: Kāyo te rathasaññāto manosārathiko lahu avihiṃsāsāritakkho saṃvibhāgapaṭicchado
ja545:187.1: Alīnacittasanthāro vaddhasevī rajohato, sati patodo dhīrassa, dhiti yogo ca rasmiyo,
ja545:188.1: Mano dantaṃ path' anveti samadantehi vāhihi icchā lobho ca kummaggo, ujumaggo ca saññamo.
ja545:189.1: Rūpe sadde rase gandhe vāhanassa padhāvato paññā ākoṭanī rāja tattha attā va sārathi.
ja545:190.1: Sace etena yānena samacariyā daḷhā dhiti sabbakāmaduho rāja na jātu nirayaṃ vaje ti.
ja545:191.1: Alāto Devadatto 'si, Sunāmo āsi Bhaddaji, Vijayo Sāriputto 'si, Mogallāno 'si Bījako.
ja545:192.1: Sunakkhatto Licchavīputto Guṇo āsi acelako, Ānando ca Rujā āsi yā rājānaṃ pasādayi.
ja545:193.1: Uruvelakassapo rājā pāpadiṭṭhi tadā ahu, Mahābrahmā Bodhisatto, evaṃ dhāretha jātakan ti.
